==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*(s)tewd-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|student}}, {{m|enm|studient}}, from {{der|en|fro|estudiant}}, {{m|fro|estudiente}}, from {{der|en|la|studēns}}, present participle of {{m|la|studeō|t=dedicate oneself to, study}}. Equivalent to {{af|en|study|-ent|alt1=stud(y)}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈstjuː.dn̩t/}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈst͡ʃuː.dn̩t/|a=yod-coalescence,RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈstu.dn̩t/|a=yod-dropping,US,CA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈstɪʊ.dənt/|a=Wales,dialectal}}
* {{hyph|en|stu|dent}}
* {{audio|en|En-uk-student.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-student.ogg|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-student.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhymes|en|uːdənt|s=2}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[person]] who [[study|studies]] or [[learn]]s about a particular [[subject]].
#: {{syn|en|candlewaster|scholar|devotee|disciple}}
#: {{ux|en|She is a '''student''' of human interactions.}}
#: {{ux|en|He is a '''student''' of life.}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Twelfth Night|IV|ii|271|1|I am not tall enough to become the function well, nor leane enough to bee thought a good '''Studient''' : but to be ſaid an honeſt man and a good houſkeeper goes as fairely, as to ſay, a carefull man, & a great ſcholler. The Competitors enter.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|title=Seashore Plants of Southern Califonria|passage=The '''student''' of marine life in Southern California should become aware that {{...}} a great many changes have taken place during the past century that have modified the characters of the plant and animal communities of the seashore.|year=1966|author=E. Yale Dawson|page=6|isbn=0520003004|year_published=1975|lccn=66-19103|publisher=University of California Press|edition_plain=3rd printing|location=Berkley|pageurl=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Seashore_Plants_of_Southern_California/b_bBAqehDCMC?gbpv=1&pg=PA6}}
# A person who is formally [[enrolled]] at a [[school]], a [[college]] or [[university]], or another educational institution.
#: {{ux|en|The '''students''' were out raising funds for [[rag week]].}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1971
|author=w:Lyndon Johnson
|title=w:The Vantage Point
|url=https://archive.org/details/vantagepointpers00john/
|publisher=w:Holt, Reinhart & Winston
|ISBN=0-03-084492-4
|LCCN=74-102146
|OCLC=1067880747
|page=180
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/vantagepointpers00john/page/180/
|text=A handful of young '''students''' bent on showing their patriotism had stirred up more trouble than they possibly could have imagined.}}
## {{lb|en|in particular}} A person who is enrolled at a [[college]] or [[university]] {{q|as contrasted with a [[pupil]] or [[schoolchild]] attending a [[primary school|primary]] or [[secondary school]]}}.
